name: NFSMW-Upper Radar / replica from NFS:MW 2005
description: The radar detector under the mirror from NFS:MW 2005, warning of trouble on the track ahead: a car stopped, crawling, going backwards or stranded off the track. The closer it is, the more lights burn and the faster they blink and beep; far away they just glow. The arrow points to it.

settings.label: Fast blinking closer than
settings.description: Closer than this the lights blink fast, faster still as the trouble nears.

settings.label: Blinking closer than
settings.description: Closer than this the lights blink slowly; further away (up to 1000 m) they glow without blinking.

settings.label: Arrow to the trouble
settings.description: The arrow in the dome points to the trouble (iRacing and Le Mans Ultimate); elsewhere it points ahead.

settings.label: Beep
settings.description: The game's radar beep with every blink. Silent while the layout is edited and in demo mode.
